title: Resphinx
tagline: Property management for rent collection, repairs and tenant chat

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Landlords, caretakers and agencies still chase rent over messaging threads and spreadsheets. Tenants cannot see what they owe, repair tickets disappear and payment status is reconstructed by hand each month.

approach.title: How I approached it
approach.body: I built Resphinx at resphinx.versacarte.com. Managers add properties and units, tenants pay through hosted checkout, ledgers update when rent lands and chat stays tied to the unit instead of personal inboxes.

technologies.title: Technologies
items: Web app for managers and tenants
Android install from the product site
Desktop builds for Windows and Linux
Secure hosted payments and a live unit ledger
In-app chat and maintenance tickets per unit

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.body: Open it at resphinx.versacarte.com to collect rent, track balances, manage repairs and message tenants in one place.
